speaker: george_bryan
text: He asked me, before we were well in the door, whether I had brought a verdict. I brought a purse, a rising, and two names. I did not bring a verdict.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Was he pleased? I am asking by daylight, Will, and George is here, so I cannot pretend it was only the cold.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Pleased is a face. A powerful man's face is not a verdict. I have decided not to read it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then what am I to do with "he said he'd remember"? I walked it home. The cold did not make it smaller.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou art to leave it. It is what he said. It is not a licence, and it is not a blow.

speaker: george_bryan
text: What I saw, and no more than I saw. The steward was courteous. The purse was in John's hand before the last speech, and not after it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Before. Then it was not a payment for the sentence.

speaker: george_bryan
text: I did not say that. I said before, and not after. The purse did not wait on the words. I will not tell you what the words waited on.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Five pounds. Twelve and six. The glass is four shillings, and it is not off the five. That is a reckoning. A reckoning is not a smile.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Lady Hoby thanked the boys by name. Nicholas, and Arthur. She did not thank "the boys."

speaker: richard_burbage
text: She runs a room. Did he thank anyone?

speaker: george_bryan
text: He rose when the women rose, and he did not rise before. That is the courtesy I have. I am not translating a courtesy into pleasure.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we will not translate it at this table. The face is shut. The work is open.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The work, then. The Queen's entrance, in the garden. Was it late?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It was late. Thou felt it, and I felt it. Late is a fact. Late can be mended without a councillor.

speaker: george_bryan
text: A note for their floor, or a note for ours? I will not have a parlour's timing walked into this yard by kindness.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The note is the entrance. This yard is not their floor. The public book stays cut. I am not putting the three leaves back because a groom was a breath behind.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The shortened groom scene. On a floor six paces wide. Did it hold?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It held. Six paces, and it held. That is a thing we can judge. His eyebrow is not in the book.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Six paces is what I paced. If the groom held there, he will hold where the stage is wider. I would not fatten the scene to be kind.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then tell me which lateness I carry. The Queen, or the groom?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Queen was late in the garden. Carry that. The groom held. Do not carry a face.

speaker: george_bryan
text: I will tell Augustine the entrance. I will not tell him a sentence. John has the purse. The leaves went back into the chest. I saw the chest shut.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: If I ask you tomorrow whether the little man was pleased, thou wilt give me this again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will give you the work. The entrance was late. The groom held. The face is not a part.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Then this morning is the king the yard has, not the king the parlour had. I am content. Content is not the same word as pleased.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: A late entrance. I have those words. I will not fatten them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three words will hold it. Go and make the entrance earlier. Leave the man where he is sitting.
